summary.zh-CN: 34岁女性第一次怀孕，足月破膜后在手术室准备剖宫产。你是在场的麻醉医生：完成麻醉前核查，在她情况突变时带领团队处理，并把她安全交给重症监护团队。基于已发表病例的历史资料回看，缺失资料保持未知。
summary.en: A 34-year-old in her first pregnancy is in theatre for a caesarean after her waters broke at term. As the anaesthetist, complete the pre-anaesthetic check, lead the team when her condition changes, and hand her over safely to intensive care. A review of a published case; missing data stay unknown.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别剖宫产术中突发的低氧、低血压和凝血功能异常（本例之前已有心前区及腹部不适、呕吐和胎心减慢）为可能的羊水栓塞，并立即呼叫多学科团队（SMFM 2016；中国2018共识）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise sudden hypoxaemia, hypotension and coagulopathy during a caesarean — here preceded by chest and abdominal discomfort, vomiting and a fetal bradycardia — as possible amniotic fluid embolism, and call the multidisciplinary team at once (SMFM 2016; Chinese 2018 consensus).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按先后次序处理：保证氧合与通气，用血管活性药和正性肌力药支持循环，必要时立即娩出胎儿；补液每次限量（不超过500 mL），避免加重右心衰竭（SMFM 2016；SMFM检查清单2021/2026）。
learningOutcomes.en: Prioritise oxygenation and ventilation, vasopressor and inotropic support and prompt delivery, giving fluid only in limited boluses (no more than 500 mL each) so as not to overload a failing right ventricle (SMFM 2016; SMFM checklist 2021/2026).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 结合妊娠晚期生理解读凝血结果（足月纤维蛋白原1.38 g/L明显偏低），并在大量输血方案中尽早补充纤维蛋白原，不用肝素（SMFM 2016；中国2018共识）。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret the clotting results against late-pregnancy physiology (a fibrinogen of 1.38 g/L at term is markedly low) and replace fibrinogen early within a massive transfusion protocol, without heparin (SMFM 2016; Chinese 2018 consensus).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 依据记录逐一鉴别围产期循环衰竭的其他原因：产科出血、药物过敏、高位椎管内阻滞、误吸和肺栓塞。
learningOutcomes.en: Work through the differential of peripartum collapse from the recorded findings: obstetric haemorrhage, drug anaphylaxis, a high neuraxial block, aspiration and pulmonary embolism.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 比较Clark 2016研究定义与中国2018共识的临床诊断标准，说明为什么羊水栓塞仍是排除其他病因后的临床诊断。
learningOutcomes.en: Compare the Clark 2016 research case definition with the Chinese 2018 clinical criteria and explain why amniotic fluid embolism remains a clinical diagnosis of exclusion.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分原报告的历史处理（激素、多巴胺、补碱、快速补液）与现行有证据支持的推荐，并说明差别所在。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish the report's historical measures (corticosteroids, dopamine, bicarbonate, rapid fluids) from current evidence-based recommendations, and explain where they differ.

notes.zh-CN: 依据已发表的病例报告改写（见引文）。患者使用化名；医院、日历日期和作者单位不出现在病例文字中，时间以相对时间表示（住院第2天、术后第2天）。病史、体征、检查、原报告的处理和结局均按原文；未记录的数据保持未知，不补写正常值。原文中两处不一致照录并标明来源：PT在病例部分记为“延长”、在讨论部分为12.5 s且无参考范围；血制品在病例部分记为入ICU后“术后共输”，讨论部分则写麻醉医生处理时即输注血浆、冷沉淀和血小板。原文也未写明腰麻是否已实施。决策、选项、评分、对话和人物性格为教学设计；正确选项依据所引的现行指南，复盘时与原报告的历史处理对照。原文无配图；原报告PDF的第2页（原刊第79页）大部分为另一篇文章，只在完成病例后开放。
notes.en: Adapted from a published case report (see the citation). The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, calendar dates and the authors' institution do not appear in the case text, and times are relative (hospital day 2, postoperative day 2). History, findings, results, the report's management and the outcome follow the source; unrecorded data stay unknown, with no normal values filled in. Two inconsistencies in the source are kept and labelled: the PT is 'prolonged' in the case presentation but 12.5 s without a reference range in the discussion; and blood products are given 'after the operation' in ICU in the case presentation, while the discussion has the anaesthetist giving plasma, cryoprecipitate and platelets during the initial management. The source also does not say whether the spinal was ever given. Decisions, options, scoring, dialogue and personality are educational design; the correct options follow the cited current guidance, and the debrief contrasts them with the report's historical management. The article has no figures; page 2 of the source PDF (journal p. 79) is mostly another article and opens only after the case is complete.

personality.en: A 34-year-old in her first pregnancy: cooperative and polite, a little nervous; answers the doctor's questions carefully and says plainly when she does not know something rather than guessing.

actingNotes.zh-CN: 手术台上清醒、紧张但配合。摆腰麻体位后突然觉得胸口和肚子难受并呕吐，此后说话简短、带着害怕。从全麻诱导插管起直到术后第2天拔管，她无法说话。最后一个阶段（术后第6天）她疲倦但平静。只讲已问到的病史，用自己的话说，不增减数字、时间或药名；病历没有记录的就直说没有记录。
actingNotes.en: Awake on the operating table, nervous but cooperative. After being positioned for the spinal she suddenly feels awful in her chest and tummy and vomits; from then on she speaks in short, frightened phrases. From the induction of general anaesthesia until extubation on postoperative day 2 she cannot speak. In the last phase (postoperative day 6) she is tired but calm. State only the history that has been asked about, in your own words, without adding or changing numbers, times or drug names; say plainly when something is not recorded.

description.en: In theatre. She is on the operating table for a caesarean under a planned spinal. Complete the pre-anaesthetic check first.

description.zh-CN: 她在协助下右侧卧位准备腰麻。她刚侧过身就说很难受，随即呕吐。
description.en: She is helped onto her right side for the spinal. Moments later she says she feels awful, and vomits.

description.zh-CN: 手术结束，她带气管导管、机械通气转入ICU，由ICU团队接手。

note.zh-CN: 原文未给参考范围。病例部分写“PT、APTT延长，纤维蛋白原下降”；讨论部分给出PT 12.5 s——这个数值在许多实验室的参考范围之内，与“延长”的说法不完全一致，两处均照原文保留。D-二聚体单位按原文（未注明FEU或DDU）。血小板计数未报告。

name.zh-CN: 麻醉记录（手术室处理摘要）
name.en: Anaesthetic record (summary of the theatre management)

text.zh-CN: 全麻：环状软骨按压下快速顺序诱导插管，过程顺利，接呼吸机机械通气。手术开始后5分钟内娩出一名男活婴，Apgar评分5-7-8-9分。期间SpO₂降至85%后测不出，全身发绀，血压持续下降，最低41/29 mmHg。处理：肾上腺素、去甲肾上腺素及多巴胺维持血压；氢化可的松、肾上腺素“抗过敏”；快速补液、补碱、调整呼吸参数；通知院内MET小组协助抢救；行左肱动脉及右颈内静脉穿刺置管，监测血压和中心静脉压。处理后血压回升但仍波动，SpO₂仍测不出。手术结束时血压102/62 mmHg，心率120–130次/分，SpO₂测不出，带气管导管机械通气送ICU。
text.en: General anaesthesia: rapid-sequence induction with cricoid pressure, uncomplicated intubation, then mechanical ventilation. A live baby boy was delivered within 5 minutes of the start of the operation (Apgar 5-7-8-9). Meanwhile her SpO₂ fell to 85% and then became unreadable, she became cyanosed all over and her blood pressure kept falling, to a lowest of 41/29 mmHg. Management: adrenaline, noradrenaline and dopamine to support the blood pressure; hydrocortisone and adrenaline as 'anti-allergy' treatment; rapid fluids, bicarbonate and ventilator adjustment; the hospital MET was called; left brachial arterial and right internal jugular venous catheters were placed to monitor the blood pressure and central venous pressure. With treatment her blood pressure rose but kept fluctuating, and the SpO₂ stayed unreadable. At the end of the operation: BP 102/62 mmHg, heart rate 120–130/min, SpO₂ unreadable; she went to ICU intubated and ventilated.

source.zh-CN: 原文·病例（患者）部分；对话措辞为教学改写。
source.en: Source: the case presentation; dialogue wording adapted for teaching.

note.zh-CN: 药物剂量、液体种类和总量、碳酸氢钠用量和给药时点原文均未记录；Apgar评分的评分时间点未列明。讨论部分另述麻醉医生按围术期羊水栓塞处理指引给予纯氧通气、维持循环、降低肺动脉压力、抗过敏、补碱纠酸及利尿，输注血浆、汇集冷沉淀、血小板，并通知ECMO团队到场待命；降低肺动脉压力和利尿所用的药物未写明。
note.en: Drug doses, the type and total volume of fluid, the bicarbonate dose and the timing of each drug are not recorded; the times of the Apgar scores are not given. The discussion adds that the anaesthetist, following a perioperative amniotic fluid embolism protocol, gave 100% oxygen, circulatory support, treatment to lower pulmonary artery pressure, anti-allergy treatment, bicarbonate and diuresis, transfused plasma, pooled cryoprecipitate and platelets, and had the ECMO team come to stand by; the drugs used to lower pulmonary pressure and for diuresis are not named.

name.zh-CN: ICU病程与随访记录

text.zh-CN: 入ICU后持续用血管活性药维持血压，激素“抗敏”，输血（术后共输同型红细胞4 U、新鲜冰冻血浆4 U、冷沉淀10 U、血小板4 U），抗感染、护胃及对症支持治疗。各项生命体征逐渐恢复正常；术后第2天拔除气管导管，第3天转普通病房；术后第6天无发热、精神可、生命体征平稳、伤口无红肿渗出，顺利出院。作者的诊断：羊水栓塞——在排除产科出血、过敏反应、高位椎管内阻滞等其他原因后确定。
text.en: In ICU: continuous vasoactive drugs for the blood pressure, steroids as 'anti-allergy' treatment, transfusion (after the operation, a total of 4 U of group-specific red cells, 4 U of fresh frozen plasma, 10 U of cryoprecipitate and 4 U of platelets), anti-infective treatment, gastric protection and supportive care. Her vital signs gradually returned to normal; she was extubated on postoperative day 2 and moved to the ward on day 3; on day 6 she was afebrile, in good spirits, with stable vital signs and a clean wound, and went home. The authors' diagnosis: amniotic fluid embolism, made after excluding obstetric haemorrhage, anaphylaxis, a high neuraxial block and other causes.

source.zh-CN: 原文·病例部分与讨论部分。
source.en: Source: the case presentation and the discussion.

note.zh-CN: ECMO未实际使用。抗菌药物、护胃药物和激素的名称与剂量未记录，血制品的单位按原文（本地单位定义未说明）。病例部分把血制品记为入ICU后“术后共输”，讨论部分则写麻醉医生处理时即输注血浆、冷沉淀和血小板——手术室内是否已输部分未说明。长期母婴结局（包括婴儿神经发育）未报告。
note.en: ECMO was not used. The names and doses of the antibiotics, gastric protection and steroids are not recorded, and blood-product units are as published (local unit definitions not stated). The case presentation places the blood products 'after the operation' in ICU, while the discussion has the anaesthetist transfusing plasma, cryoprecipitate and platelets during the initial management — whether some were given in theatre is not stated. Long-term outcomes for mother and baby (including the baby's development) are not reported.

name.zh-CN: 建立外周静脉通路（大口径套管）并抽血
name.en: Peripheral IV access (large-bore cannula) and bloods

dose.zh-CN: 大口径外周静脉套管，同时抽血送检。
dose.en: Large-bore peripheral cannula, taking bloods at the same time.

response.zh-CN: 大口径外周静脉套管已置入，血标本已采集。（原报告未记录外周静脉通路的情况。）
response.en: A large-bore peripheral cannula is in and bloods are taken. (The report does not record her peripheral IV access.)

name.zh-CN: 改为仰卧并左推子宫（楔形垫或手法）
name.en: Lie her on her back with left uterine displacement (wedge or manual)

response.zh-CN: 她被转回仰卧位，子宫推向左侧，解除对下腔静脉和主动脉的压迫。（原报告记为“即予平卧位”，是否加用左倾或左推子宫未记录。）
response.en: She is turned onto her back with the uterus pushed to the left, off the vena cava and aorta. (The report records 'laid supine at once'; whether tilt or uterine displacement was used is not recorded.)

name.zh-CN: 面罩吸氧

dose.zh-CN: 面罩吸氧（原报告未记录氧流量）。
dose.en: Oxygen by face mask (the report does not record the flow rate).

response.zh-CN: 面罩吸氧已给上。
response.en: Face-mask oxygen is on.

name.zh-CN: 全身麻醉：环状软骨按压下快速顺序诱导、气管插管、机械通气
name.en: General anaesthesia: rapid-sequence induction with cricoid pressure, tracheal intubation and ventilation

dose.zh-CN: 快速顺序诱导，环状软骨按压，气管插管后机械通气；诱导药物和剂量由麻醉医生按体重和循环状况决定。
dose.en: Rapid-sequence induction with cricoid pressure, tracheal intubation, then mechanical ventilation; induction drugs and doses chosen by the anaesthetist for her weight and circulation.

response.zh-CN: 环状软骨按压下快速顺序诱导，插管顺利，已接呼吸机机械通气。（原报告未记录诱导用药。）
response.en: Rapid-sequence induction with cricoid pressure; intubation is uncomplicated and she is on the ventilator. (The report does not record the induction drugs.)

name.zh-CN: 请产科医生立即开始剖宫产（即刻娩出）
name.en: Ask the obstetrician to start the caesarean now (category 1)

harm.zh-CN: 她还没有麻醉：剖宫产必须在麻醉起效后才能开始（本例为快速顺序诱导全麻）。
harm.en: She is not anaesthetised yet: the caesarean can only start once an anaesthetic is working (here, rapid-sequence general anaesthesia).

response.zh-CN: 麻醉起效后，产科医生立即开始剖宫产；手术开始5分钟内娩出一名男活婴。
response.en: Once the anaesthetic is working the obstetrician starts the caesarean at once; a live baby boy is delivered within 5 minutes of the start.

name.zh-CN: 呼叫院内MET及产科、麻醉上级医生
name.en: Call the hospital MET and senior obstetric and anaesthetic help

response.zh-CN: MET小组和产科、麻醉上级医生赶来协助。（原报告记录通知了院内MET小组协助抢救。）
response.en: The MET and senior obstetric and anaesthetic staff come to help. (The report records that the hospital MET was called to help.)

name.zh-CN: 通知ECMO团队到场待命
name.en: Ask the ECMO team to stand by

response.zh-CN: ECMO团队到场待命，必要时可经股动静脉插管建立体外生命支持。（原报告记录ECMO团队到场待命。）
response.en: The ECMO team comes to stand by, ready for femoral cannulation if it is needed. (The report records the ECMO team standing by.)

name.zh-CN: 纯氧通气并调整呼吸机参数
name.en: Ventilate with 100% oxygen and adjust the ventilator

response.zh-CN: 吸入氧浓度调至100%，并调整通气参数。（病例部分：调整呼吸参数；讨论部分：纯氧呼吸。）
response.en: FiO₂ is set to 1.0 and the ventilation adjusted. (Case presentation: ventilator settings adjusted; discussion: 100% oxygen.)

name.zh-CN: 去甲肾上腺素持续静脉泵注

dose.zh-CN: 微量泵持续静脉输注（条件允许时经中心静脉），小剂量起始（如0.05 µg/kg/min），按血压滴定。
dose.en: Continuous IV infusion by syringe pump (central line when available), started low (e.g. 0.05 µg/kg/min) and titrated to blood pressure.

response.zh-CN: 去甲肾上腺素泵注开始，按血压滴定。（原报告同时使用了肾上腺素、去甲肾上腺素和多巴胺，剂量未记录。）
response.en: Noradrenaline is running, titrated to her blood pressure. (The report used adrenaline, noradrenaline and dopamine together; doses are not recorded.)

name.zh-CN: 肾上腺素静脉小剂量推注
name.en: Adrenaline IV in small titrated boluses

dose.zh-CN: 由有经验的麻醉医生小剂量静脉推注、按效应滴定（剂量按本院方案）；1 mg静推只用于心脏骤停。
dose.en: Small IV boluses titrated to effect by an experienced anaesthetist (dose per local protocol); 1 mg IV boluses are for cardiac arrest only.

response.zh-CN: 已给肾上腺素。（原报告用肾上腺素维持血压并“抗过敏”，剂量未记录；经处理后血压回升但仍波动。）
response.en: Adrenaline given. (The report used adrenaline both for the blood pressure and as 'anti-allergy' treatment, doses not recorded; with treatment her blood pressure rose but kept fluctuating.)

name.zh-CN: 多巴胺静脉泵注

dose.zh-CN: 微量泵持续静脉输注，按血压滴定（剂量按本院方案）。
dose.en: Continuous IV infusion by pump, titrated to blood pressure (dose per local protocol).

response.zh-CN: 多巴胺泵注开始。原报告使用了多巴胺；SMFM 2016的推荐只写“按血流动力学使用血管活性药和正性肌力药”，没有指定多巴胺，单例报告也不能说明它的独立作用。
response.en: Dopamine is running. The report used dopamine; SMFM 2016 recommends 'vasopressors and inotropic agents as the haemodynamics indicate' without naming dopamine, and a single case cannot show what it added.

name.zh-CN: 多巴酚丁胺静脉泵注（右心衰竭时的正性肌力支持）
name.en: Dobutamine IV infusion (inotropic support for right-ventricular failure)

dose.zh-CN: 微量泵持续静脉输注，常用2.5–5.0 µg/kg/min（中国2018共识相关解读所列范围，以本院方案为准），按反应调整。
dose.en: Continuous IV infusion by pump, commonly 2.5–5.0 µg/kg/min (the range given in commentary on the Chinese 2018 consensus; follow the local protocol), adjusted to response.

response.zh-CN: 多巴酚丁胺泵注开始。原报告没有使用正性肌力药。SMFM 2016支持按血流动力学使用正性肌力药，右心衰竭时有益；但本例术中超声报告右室不大、左室射血分数正常（检查时点未记录），而且严重低血压时多巴酚丁胺可使血压进一步下降，需同时使用升压药。
response.en: Dobutamine is running. The report used no inotrope. SMFM 2016 supports inotropes as the haemodynamics indicate, and they help a failing right ventricle; but here the intra-operative echo reported a non-dilated right ventricle with a normal ejection fraction (timing not recorded), and in severe hypotension dobutamine can lower the blood pressure further unless a vasopressor is running.

name.zh-CN: 氢化可的松静脉滴注（原报告的“抗过敏”用药）

dose.zh-CN: 原报告未记录剂量；中国2018共识所列：氢化可的松500–1000 mg/d静脉滴注。
dose.en: Dose not recorded in the report; the Chinese 2018 consensus gives hydrocortisone 500–1000 mg/day IV.

response.zh-CN: 已给氢化可的松。糖皮质激素治疗羊水栓塞缺乏证据：SMFM 2016没有推荐；中国2018共识认为存在争议，但基于临床经验，早期大剂量使用“应作为有益的尝试”。原报告在手术室和ICU都用了激素。
response.en: Hydrocortisone given. There is no good evidence for corticosteroids in amniotic fluid embolism: SMFM 2016 does not recommend them; the Chinese 2018 consensus calls them controversial but, from clinical experience, regards early high-dose use as 'a worthwhile attempt'. The report used steroids in theatre and in ICU.

name.zh-CN: 晶体液500 mL快速输注后再评估

dose.zh-CN: 平衡晶体液500 mL快速输注，评估反应后再决定是否追加（SMFM检查清单作者建议每次补液不超过500 mL）。
dose.en: 500 mL of balanced crystalloid rapidly, then reassess before giving any more (the SMFM checklist's authors limit each challenge to 500 mL).

response.zh-CN: 500 mL晶体液已快速输入，正在评估反应。
response.en: 500 mL of crystalloid is in; her response is being assessed.

name.zh-CN: 加压快速大量输注晶体液，直到血压恢复正常
name.en: Rapid large-volume crystalloid under pressure until the blood pressure is normal

dose.zh-CN: 加压袋快速输注，连续数升、不设上限，直到血压正常。
dose.en: Pressure bags, several litres in a row with no ceiling, until the blood pressure is normal.

harm.zh-CN: 羊水栓塞早期以急性右心衰竭为主，右心室对容量负荷很敏感：大量快速补液会加重右心衰竭和肺水肿。SMFM 2016：避免过量补液（GRADE 1C）；SMFM检查清单作者建议需要补液时每次不超过500 mL。原报告记录了“快速补液”，但没有写输液量。
harm.en: Early amniotic fluid embolism is dominated by acute right-heart failure, and the right ventricle is very sensitive to volume: large, rapid fluid loads worsen right-heart failure and pulmonary oedema. SMFM 2016: avoid excessive fluid (GRADE 1C); the SMFM checklist's authors limit any fluid challenge to 500 mL. The report records 'rapid fluids' but not the volume.

response.zh-CN: 加压输液进行中。
response.en: Pressure-bag infusion running.

name.zh-CN: 碳酸氢钠静脉输注（补碱）

dose.zh-CN: 原报告未记录用量。
dose.en: The report does not record the dose.

response.zh-CN: 已给碳酸氢钠。pH 7.15是呼吸性合并代谢性酸中毒：呼吸性部分要靠通气纠正，代谢性部分要靠恢复灌注；碳酸氢钠不能治疗病因。原报告的处理包括“补碱”。
response.en: Bicarbonate given. A pH of 7.15 here is a combined respiratory and metabolic acidosis: ventilation corrects the respiratory part and restoring perfusion the metabolic part; bicarbonate does not treat the cause. The report's management included bicarbonate.

name.zh-CN: 动脉穿刺置管、有创血压监测（原报告为左肱动脉）
name.en: Arterial line for invasive blood pressure and sampling (left brachial in the report)

dose.zh-CN: 动脉穿刺置管，接压力换能器持续监测血压并便于采血。
dose.en: Arterial cannulation connected to a pressure transducer for continuous blood pressure and blood sampling.

response.zh-CN: 动脉置管完成，开始有创血压监测。（原报告：左肱动脉穿刺置管。）
response.en: The arterial line is in and invasive blood pressure monitoring has started. (The report: a left brachial arterial line.)

name.zh-CN: 中心静脉置管（原报告为右颈内静脉）
name.en: Central venous catheter (right internal jugular in the report)

dose.zh-CN: 颈内静脉置管（条件允许时超声引导），用于中心静脉压监测和血管活性药输注。
dose.en: Internal jugular catheter (ultrasound-guided when available) for central venous pressure monitoring and vasoactive drugs.

response.zh-CN: 中心静脉置管完成，可监测中心静脉压，也可经此输注血管活性药。（原报告：右颈内静脉穿刺置管。）
response.en: The central line is in, for central venous pressure monitoring and vasoactive infusions. (The report: a right internal jugular catheter.)

name.zh-CN: 启动大量输血方案，通知血库
name.en: Activate the massive transfusion protocol (call the blood bank)

response.zh-CN: 血库按大量输血方案准备红细胞、血浆、血小板和冷沉淀，陆续送到手术室。（原报告没有提到大量输血方案，只记录了输注的血制品。）
response.en: The blood bank prepares red cells, plasma, platelets and cryoprecipitate under the massive transfusion protocol and sends them to theatre. (The report does not mention a massive transfusion protocol; it records only the products given.)

name.zh-CN: 冷沉淀（补充纤维蛋白原）

dose.zh-CN: 按纤维蛋白原结果给予，复查后追加（本报告共输冷沉淀10 U；本地单位定义未说明）。
dose.en: Given against the fibrinogen result and repeated as rechecks show (the report gave 10 U in total; local unit definition not stated).

response.zh-CN: 冷沉淀开始输注；稍后复查凝血功能和纤维蛋白原。
response.en: Cryoprecipitate is going in; clotting and fibrinogen will be rechecked afterwards.

name.zh-CN: 新鲜冰冻血浆

dose.zh-CN: 按大量输血方案的配比给予（本报告术后共输4 U）。
dose.en: Given in the ratio of the massive transfusion protocol (the report gave 4 U after the operation).

response.zh-CN: 血浆开始输注。血浆补充凝血因子，但每单位含纤维蛋白原较少而容量较大；SMFM检查清单作者建议担心容量负荷时以冷沉淀代替血浆。
response.en: Plasma is going in. It replaces clotting factors but carries relatively little fibrinogen for its volume; the SMFM checklist's authors suggest cryoprecipitate instead of plasma when volume overload is a concern.

name.zh-CN: 血小板

dose.zh-CN: 按大量输血方案或血小板计数给予（本报告共输4 U；血小板计数未报告）。
dose.en: Given within the massive transfusion protocol or by the platelet count (the report gave 4 U; no platelet count is reported).

response.zh-CN: 血小板开始输注。
response.en: Platelets are going in.

name.zh-CN: 同型红细胞

dose.zh-CN: 按出血量和血红蛋白给予（本报告术后共输4 U）。
dose.en: Given by blood loss and haemoglobin (the report gave 4 U after the operation).

response.zh-CN: 红细胞开始输注。（血气报告“Hb不低”；失血量原文未记录。）
response.en: Red cells are going in. (The blood gas reported 'Hb not low'; the blood loss is not recorded.)

name.zh-CN: 普通肝素静脉治疗DIC

dose.zh-CN: 静脉普通肝素（剂量按本院方案）。
dose.en: IV unfractionated heparin (dose per local protocol).

harm.zh-CN: 用肝素治疗羊水栓塞所致DIC争议很大，中国2018共识认为弊大于利、不常规推荐（除非有早期高凝状态的依据）；她已有纤维蛋白原下降和凝血时间延长，肝素会加重出血。
harm.en: Heparin for the DIC of amniotic fluid embolism is highly controversial; the Chinese 2018 consensus judges that it does more harm than good and does not recommend it routinely (unless there is evidence of an early hypercoagulable phase). Her fibrinogen is already low and her clotting times prolonged, so heparin would worsen bleeding.

response.zh-CN: 肝素已给。
response.en: Heparin given.

name.zh-CN: 带管转入ICU，并做结构化交接（SBAR）
name.en: Transfer to ICU intubated and ventilated, with a structured (SBAR) handover

response.zh-CN: ICU同意接收。手术结束、她能转运时，由麻醉团队带气管导管、机械通气护送入ICU，并向ICU团队交接。
response.en: ICU accepts her. Once the operation is finished and she can be moved, the anaesthetic team takes her to ICU intubated and ventilated and hands over to the ICU team.

name.zh-CN: ICU继续机械通气
name.en: Continue mechanical ventilation on the ICU ventilator

response.zh-CN: 已接ICU呼吸机继续机械通气。（原报告记录她带气管导管机械通气送ICU。）
response.en: She is on the ICU ventilator. (The report records that she came to ICU intubated and ventilated.)

name.zh-CN: 抗菌药物（原报告记为“抗感染”，药名未记录）
name.en: Antibiotics (the report's 'anti-infective' treatment; drug not recorded)

dose.zh-CN: 原报告未记录药名、剂量和用药指征。
dose.en: The report does not record the drug, dose or indication.

response.zh-CN: 已开始抗菌药物。（原报告在ICU给予“抗感染”治疗，药名和用药原因未记录。）
response.en: Antibiotics started. (The report gave 'anti-infective' treatment in ICU; the drug and the reason are not recorded.)

name.zh-CN: 护胃（应激性溃疡预防；原报告未写药名）
name.en: Gastric protection (stress-ulcer prophylaxis; drug not named in the report)

dose.zh-CN: 原报告未记录药名和剂量。
dose.en: The report does not record the drug or dose.

response.zh-CN: 已开始护胃治疗。（原报告在ICU给予“护胃”治疗，药名未记录。）
response.en: Gastric protection started. (The report gave 'gastric protection' in ICU; the drug is not recorded.)

hint.zh-CN: 破水的时间和羊水的样子、为什么剖宫产、麻醉打算怎么做，还有每位麻醉医生都要先问清的几件事（进食、过敏、既往病）；再看入室生命体征和胎心。
hint.en: When the waters broke and what the fluid looked like, why she needs a caesarean, the anaesthetic plan, and the things every anaesthetist checks first (food and drink, allergies, past illnesses); then her vital signs on arrival and the fetal heart.

guidance.zh-CN: 在手术台旁完成麻醉前核查。
guidance.en: Complete the pre-anaesthetic check at the operating table.

hint.zh-CN: 她说哪里不舒服？胎儿现在怎样？先处理好她的体位和氧合，再决定这次分娩接下来怎么进行。
hint.en: What is she feeling? How is the baby now? Sort out her position and oxygen first, then decide how the birth goes from here.

guidance.zh-CN: 问清她的不适，复测胎心，调整体位并给氧，然后作出决策并执行。
guidance.en: Find out what she feels, re-check the fetal heart, reposition her and give oxygen, then decide and act.

hint.zh-CN: 她此刻的气道、呼吸、循环怎样？哪些人需要马上到场？先保证氧合和灌注。
hint.en: Where are her airway, breathing and circulation right now? Who needs to be here now? Secure oxygenation and perfusion first.

guidance.zh-CN: 评估她，呼叫帮助，保证通气和循环支持。
guidance.en: Assess her, call for help, and secure ventilation and circulatory support.

title.en: Find the cause; correct the clotting

hint.zh-CN: 血气、凝血和心脏超声各说明了什么？哪些原因能解释术中的心肺衰竭，记录又排除了哪些？足月孕妇的纤维蛋白原本应是什么水平？
hint.en: What do the blood gas, the clotting and the echo each tell you? Which causes could explain the collapse, and which does the record rule out? What level of fibrinogen would you expect at term?

guidance.zh-CN: 送检血气和凝血，做心脏超声，作出判断并处理凝血异常。
guidance.en: Send the gas and the clotting, get the echo, make your judgement and treat the coagulopathy.

hint.zh-CN: 她能离开手术室了吗？交给ICU时要讲清哪些？ICU接手后哪些支持要继续？
hint.en: Is she ready to leave theatre? What must the ICU team hear? What support carries on once they take over?

guidance.zh-CN: 把她送入ICU，核对交接时的情况，阅读麻醉记录，继续机械通气。
guidance.en: Take her to ICU, check her state at handover, read the anaesthetic record and continue ventilation.

hint.zh-CN: 她恢复得怎样？对照原报告的处理，你哪些地方会做得不一样？
hint.en: How has she recovered? Compared with the report's management, what would you do differently?

guidance.zh-CN: 问问她现在的情况，阅读ICU病程与随访记录。
guidance.en: Ask how she is now and read the ICU course and follow-up record.

prompt.zh-CN: 她侧过身后胸口和肚子难受并呕吐，复测胎心约60次/分。下一步怎么做？
prompt.en: After turning onto her side she has chest and abdominal discomfort and has vomited, and the fetal heart rate is now about 60/min. What next?

need.zh-CN: 先问清她哪里不舒服，并复测胎心。
need.en: First find out what she is feeling and re-check the fetal heart.

text.zh-CN: 按即刻剖宫产处理：呼叫上级和帮手，在环状软骨按压下快速顺序诱导全麻，立即娩出胎儿，同时为产妇可能的恶化做好准备
text.en: Treat it as a category-1 emergency: call senior help, give general anaesthesia by rapid-sequence induction with cricoid pressure, deliver the baby at once, and prepare for the mother to deteriorate

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。产妇出现原因不明的胸腹不适和呕吐，同时胎心约60次/分，母胎双方都可能处于危险中，分娩已刻不容缓。她刚呕吐过，误吸风险高，快速顺序诱导能最快地保护气道；同时叫来帮手、准备抢救，因为产妇本身可能正在恶化。原报告团队随即在快速顺序诱导全麻下娩出胎儿；院内MET是在产妇病情恶化后才呼叫的。
feedback.en: Correct. She has unexplained chest and abdominal discomfort and has vomited, and the fetal heart is about 60/min: mother and baby may both be in danger, so delivery cannot wait. Having just vomited she is at high risk of aspiration, and rapid-sequence induction secures the airway fastest; calling for help and preparing to resuscitate matters because the mother herself may be deteriorating. The report's team went straight to rapid-sequence general anaesthesia and delivery; the hospital MET was called once the mother deteriorated.

text.zh-CN: 等她不吐了、情况平稳后，按原计划打腰麻再手术
text.en: Wait for the vomiting to settle, then give the planned spinal and operate

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。胎心约60次/分说明胎儿可能正在缺氧，等待会延误娩出；产妇自己又出现了原因不明的症状，把手术建立在“等她平稳”上并不安全。生命体征“无明显变化”不能说明母胎安全。
feedback.en: No. A fetal heart rate of about 60/min means the baby may be becoming hypoxic, so waiting delays delivery; and the mother has unexplained symptoms of her own, so planning around 'once she settles' is unsafe. 'No clear change' in her vital signs does not mean mother and baby are safe.

text.zh-CN: 先快速补液500 mL，15分钟后复测胎心再决定
text.en: Give 500 mL of fluid and re-check the fetal heart in 15 minutes before deciding

feedback.zh-CN: 不妥。宫内复苏（体位、吸氧、补液）可以同时做，但不能代替尽快娩出：胎心持续约60次/分时再等15分钟，胎儿缺氧损伤的风险会明显增加。
feedback.en: No. In-utero resuscitation (position, oxygen, fluid) can run alongside, but it does not replace prompt delivery: another 15 minutes with the fetal heart at about 60/min adds substantially to the risk of hypoxic injury.

text.zh-CN: 暂停手术，送回产房做持续胎心监护观察
text.en: Stop, and take her back to the delivery suite for continuous CTG monitoring

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。她已经在手术室、本来就有剖宫产指征，此刻胎心约60次/分；离开手术室只会拖延娩出，也让产妇离开了最好的抢救条件。
feedback.en: Wrong. She is already in theatre with an indication for caesarean, and the fetal heart is about 60/min; leaving theatre only delays delivery and takes the mother away from the best place to resuscitate her.

prompt.zh-CN: 插管、胎儿娩出后，她的SpO₂降到85%后测不出，全身发绀，血压降至最低41/29 mmHg。现在最先要做的有哪些？（多选）
prompt.en: After intubation and delivery her SpO₂ fell to 85% and then became unreadable, she is cyanosed all over and her blood pressure has fallen to 41/29 mmHg. What do you do first? (Select all that apply.)

need.en: First assess her as she is now.

text.zh-CN: 立即呼叫帮助：院内MET及产科、麻醉上级，并通知ICU、血库和ECMO团队
text.en: Call for help now — the hospital MET and senior obstetric and anaesthetic staff — and alert ICU, the blood bank and the ECMO team

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。羊水栓塞需要多学科团队同时处理（SMFM 2016）；越早叫人，越早有人分别负责气道、循环、输血和手术止血。原报告通知了MET，并让ECMO团队到场待命。
feedback.en: Correct. Amniotic fluid embolism needs a multidisciplinary team working at once (SMFM 2016); the earlier you call, the sooner people take on the airway, the circulation, transfusion and surgical bleeding. The report's team called the MET and had the ECMO team standing by.

text.zh-CN: 纯氧通气，并用血管活性药和正性肌力药支持循环
text.en: Ventilate with 100% oxygen and support the circulation with vasopressors and inotropes

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。SMFM 2016推荐保证充分的氧合和通气，并根据血流动力学使用血管活性药和正性肌力药；早期的主要问题多是急性右心衰竭。
feedback.en: Correct. SMFM 2016 recommends adequate oxygenation and ventilation, with vasopressors and inotropes as the haemodynamics require; early on the main problem is usually acute right-heart failure.

text.zh-CN: 马上送凝血功能（含纤维蛋白原）和血气，准备启动大量输血方案
text.en: Send clotting tests (including fibrinogen) and a blood gas at once, and get ready to start the massive transfusion protocol

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。凝血障碍常紧随循环衰竭出现：SMFM 2016推荐尽早评估凝血状态，并按标准大量输血方案积极处理出血；SMFM检查清单的作者主张一旦诊断羊水栓塞就启动大量输血方案。
feedback.en: Correct. Coagulopathy often follows the collapse: SMFM 2016 recommends early assessment of clotting and aggressive management of bleeding with standard massive transfusion protocols, and the SMFM checklist's authors advise starting the protocol as soon as amniotic fluid embolism is diagnosed.

text.zh-CN: 加压快速大量补液，直到血压恢复正常
text.en: Run in large volumes of fluid under pressure until her blood pressure is normal

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。衰竭的右心室对容量很敏感，大量补液会加重右心衰竭和肺水肿。SMFM 2016：避免过量补液（GRADE 1C）；检查清单作者建议需要补液时每次不超过500 mL。原报告记录了“快速补液”，但没有写输液量。
feedback.en: Wrong. A failing right ventricle is very sensitive to volume, so large volumes worsen right-heart failure and pulmonary oedema. SMFM 2016: avoid excessive fluid (GRADE 1C); the checklist's authors limit any fluid challenge to 500 mL. The report records 'rapid fluids' without a volume.

text.zh-CN: 先等能确诊的检查结果，再开始针对性治疗
text.en: Wait for a test that confirms the diagnosis before starting specific treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。没有任何实验室检查能确诊或排除羊水栓塞（SMFM 2016）；治疗以支持为主，必须立即开始。
feedback.en: Wrong. No laboratory test confirms or excludes amniotic fluid embolism (SMFM 2016); treatment is supportive and has to start immediately.

prompt.zh-CN: 根据目前的病史、体征以及血气和凝血结果，怎样解释这次剖宫产术中的心肺循环衰竭最合适？
prompt.en: From the history, the findings and the blood gas and clotting results so far, what best explains her cardiorespiratory collapse during the caesarean?

need.zh-CN: 先评估她，并查看血气和凝血结果。
need.en: First assess her, and read the blood gas and the clotting results.

text.zh-CN: 羊水栓塞：剖宫产术中突发低血压、低氧和凝血功能异常，其他原因解释不了；这是排除其他病因后的临床诊断
text.en: Amniotic fluid embolism: sudden hypotension, hypoxaemia and abnormal clotting during the caesarean that nothing else explains — a clinical diagnosis made after excluding other causes

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。羊水栓塞没有确诊性检查，是临床诊断（SMFM 2016）。本例符合中国2018共识全部5条标准：急性低血压；急性低氧（发绀、SpO₂下降）；凝血功能异常的实验室证据（纤维蛋白原下降、凝血时间延长）；发生在剖宫产术中；其他疾病解释不了。但它不符合Clark 2016研究定义要求的“显性DIC”——血小板未报告，作者也写明没有明确的DIC。研究标准是为统一报告病例而定的，不是床旁诊断规则。
feedback.en: Correct. There is no confirmatory test: amniotic fluid embolism is a clinical diagnosis (SMFM 2016). This case meets all five criteria of the Chinese 2018 consensus — acute hypotension; acute hypoxaemia (cyanosis, falling SpO₂); laboratory evidence of coagulopathy (low fibrinogen, prolonged clotting times); onset during the caesarean; and no better explanation. It does not meet the Clark 2016 research definition, which requires overt DIC: no platelet count is reported and the authors say there was no clear DIC. Research criteria standardise case reporting; they are not a bedside rule.

text.zh-CN: 产科大出血导致的失血性休克
text.en: Haemorrhagic shock from obstetric bleeding

feedback.zh-CN: 可能性小。休克时的血气报告“Hb不低”，原文没有记录大量出血，作者也明确排除了产科出血。但失血量本身未记录，仍须持续观察出血。
feedback.en: Unlikely. The gas taken during the collapse reports 'Hb not low', no major bleeding is recorded, and the authors explicitly excluded obstetric haemorrhage. The blood loss itself was not recorded, though, so bleeding still has to be watched for.

text.zh-CN: 麻醉诱导药物引起的过敏性休克
text.en: Anaphylaxis to the induction drugs

feedback.zh-CN: 必须想到，但解释不了全貌。休克紧跟在快速诱导之后，确实要考虑药物过敏——团队也给了“抗过敏”治疗。但她的胸腹不适、呕吐和胎心减慢都发生在使用任何麻醉药物之前；记录中没有皮疹或支气管痉挛；过敏也解释不了凝血异常。作者把过敏反应列为已排除的原因，但原文没有类胰蛋白酶等检查结果。
feedback.en: Must be considered, but it does not explain the whole picture. The collapse followed rapid-sequence induction, so drug anaphylaxis has to cross your mind — and the team did give 'anti-allergy' treatment. But her chest and abdominal discomfort, the vomiting and the fetal bradycardia all came before any anaesthetic drug; no rash or bronchospasm is recorded; and anaphylaxis does not explain the coagulopathy. The authors list anaphylaxis among the causes excluded, though the report gives no tryptase or similar result.

text.zh-CN: 诱导前呕吐导致的胃内容物误吸
text.en: Aspiration of the vomit before induction

feedback.zh-CN: 不符合。她诱导前确实呕吐过，误吸会造成低氧；但血气报告PaO₂正常（采样时点和吸氧浓度未记录），而且误吸解释不了极度低血压和凝血异常。
feedback.en: Does not fit. She did vomit before induction, and aspiration causes hypoxaemia; but the gas reports a normal PaO₂ (sampling time and FiO₂ not recorded), and aspiration explains neither the profound hypotension nor the coagulopathy.

text.zh-CN: 高位或全脊髓椎管内阻滞
text.en: A high or total neuraxial block

feedback.zh-CN: 不符合。原文没有写明腰麻是否真的实施——摆体位之后记录的下一步就是全身麻醉；她的症状在摆体位时就出现了。高位阻滞也解释不了凝血异常。作者把它列为已排除的原因。
feedback.en: Does not fit. The report does not say the spinal was ever given — the next recorded step after positioning is general anaesthesia — and her symptoms began during positioning. A high block would not explain the coagulopathy either. The authors list it among the causes excluded.

prompt.zh-CN: 凝血结果：纤维蛋白原1.38 g/L，D-二聚体9.22 mcg/mL，APTT 40.2 s，PT 12.5 s。怎样处理最合适？
prompt.en: The clotting results: fibrinogen 1.38 g/L, D-dimer 9.22 mcg/mL, APTT 40.2 s, PT 12.5 s. What is the best way to manage them?

text.zh-CN: 按进展中的羊水栓塞凝血病处理：在大量输血方案中尽早补充纤维蛋白原（冷沉淀，或按本院方案用纤维蛋白原浓缩物），并复查凝血以指导后续用血
text.en: Treat it as an evolving coagulopathy of amniotic fluid embolism: replace fibrinogen early within the massive transfusion protocol (cryoprecipitate, or fibrinogen concentrate where local protocol uses it) and repeat the clotting tests to guide further products

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。妊娠晚期纤维蛋白原本应升高，1.38 g/L对足月孕妇而言明显偏低，提示消耗。SMFM 2016推荐尽早、积极地按大量输血方案处理；检查清单作者建议担心容量负荷时以冷沉淀代替血浆。原报告共输冷沉淀10 U。
feedback.en: Correct. Fibrinogen normally rises in late pregnancy, so 1.38 g/L at term is markedly low and points to consumption. SMFM 2016 recommends early, aggressive management within a massive transfusion protocol, and the checklist's authors suggest cryoprecipitate rather than plasma when volume is a concern. The report gave 10 U of cryoprecipitate in total.

text.zh-CN: PT基本正常，凝血还可以；只有出血失控时才输血制品
text.en: The PT is essentially normal, so clotting is acceptable; give products only if bleeding becomes uncontrollable

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。不能只看一个PT：纤维蛋白原已经下降，D-二聚体升高，APTT延长（原文病例部分还写明PT延长，只是讨论部分给的12.5 s没有参考范围）。等到出血失控再处理，违背了SMFM“早期积极处理”的推荐。
feedback.en: Wrong. Don't read one PT on its own: the fibrinogen has fallen, the D-dimer is raised and the APTT is prolonged (the case presentation also calls the PT prolonged; only the discussion gives 12.5 s, without a range). Waiting for uncontrolled bleeding goes against SMFM's call for early, aggressive management.

text.zh-CN: 先凑齐血小板等指标算出显性DIC评分，确诊DIC后再输血制品
text.en: Wait until an overt-DIC score can be calculated (platelets and the rest) and treat only once DIC is confirmed

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。DIC评分有助于研究和分级，但不能因此推迟治疗；羊水栓塞的凝血病可以进展得很快。
feedback.en: Wrong. A DIC score helps research and grading, but it must not delay treatment — the coagulopathy of amniotic fluid embolism can progress very quickly.

text.zh-CN: 只输大量新鲜冰冻血浆来纠正纤维蛋白原
text.en: Correct the fibrinogen with large volumes of fresh frozen plasma alone

feedback.zh-CN: 不是最好的办法。血浆每单位所含纤维蛋白原较少，要提高纤维蛋白原需要很大的容量，而容量负荷正是衰竭的右心室最难承受的；检查清单作者建议此时以冷沉淀代替血浆。
feedback.en: Not the best way. Plasma carries relatively little fibrinogen for its volume, so raising fibrinogen this way takes a large volume — exactly what a failing right ventricle tolerates worst; the checklist's authors suggest cryoprecipitate instead.

text.zh-CN: 开始静脉肝素，阻断DIC
text.en: Start IV heparin to switch off the DIC

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。中国2018共识指出，用肝素治疗羊水栓塞所致DIC争议很大、弊大于利，不常规推荐（除非有早期高凝状态的依据）；她已有纤维蛋白原下降，肝素会加重出血。
feedback.en: Wrong. The Chinese 2018 consensus calls heparin for the DIC of amniotic fluid embolism highly controversial, more harmful than helpful, and does not recommend it routinely (unless there is evidence of an early hypercoagulable phase); with her fibrinogen already low, heparin would worsen bleeding.

text.zh-CN: 完成麻醉前病史核查：破膜与羊水性状、剖宫产原因、麻醉计划、进食、过敏和既往病
text.en: Took the pre-anaesthetic history: membrane rupture and the fluid, the reason for the caesarean, the anaesthetic plan, food and drink, allergies and past illness

text.zh-CN: 核对入室生命体征和胎心，并在她不适时复测胎心
text.en: Checked her vital signs and the fetal heart on arrival, and re-checked the fetal heart when she became unwell

text.zh-CN: 出现症状后让她仰卧并左推子宫、给氧，并再次评估她的不适
text.en: When her symptoms began, laid her supine with left uterine displacement, gave oxygen and reassessed her symptoms

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确：按即刻剖宫产处理，快速顺序诱导全麻并立即娩出
text.en: Chose the right next step at the first attempt: a category-1 caesarean under rapid-sequence general anaesthesia

text.zh-CN: 及早呼叫院内MET和上级医生
text.en: Called the hospital MET and senior help early

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对首要措施，并给予纯氧通气和血管活性药支持
text.en: Chose the first actions correctly at the first attempt, and gave 100% oxygen ventilation and vasopressor support

text.zh-CN: 术中查看血气、凝血功能和心脏超声结果
text.en: Read the blood gas, the clotting screen and the echocardiogram during the collapse

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即作出羊水栓塞的临床诊断，并说明已排除的其他原因
text.en: Made the clinical diagnosis of amniotic fluid embolism at the first attempt, with the other causes excluded

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确处理凝血病：启动大量输血方案并尽早补充纤维蛋白原
text.en: Managed the coagulopathy correctly at the first attempt: massive transfusion protocol and early fibrinogen replacement

text.zh-CN: 复苏中没有加压大量补液，也没有用肝素
text.en: During resuscitation gave no large-volume pressure fluids and no heparin

text.zh-CN: 带管转入ICU，并在交接时阅读麻醉记录
text.en: Transferred her to ICU intubated, and read the anaesthetic record at handover

text.zh-CN: 危机中闭环沟通、明确分工，并用SBAR向ICU交接
text.en: Led the crisis with closed-loop communication and clear roles, and handed over to ICU with SBAR

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现：大声说出问题（如“产妇术中突然低氧、低血压，考虑羊水栓塞可能，需要帮助”），明确呼叫帮助并指定分工（气道、给药、记录、取血、联系血库/ICU/ECMO）；医嘱具体（药名、剂量、途径），并让执行者复述确认；定期小结（“现在血压……，已经给了……，下一步……”）。转ICU时用SBAR交接：情况（剖宫产术中心肺循环衰竭，考虑羊水栓塞）、背景（孕40+6周、破膜后黄绿色羊水、摆体位时胸腹不适和呕吐、快速顺序诱导、5分钟内娩出）、评估（血气、凝血、超声，目前的通气和循环支持、已输血制品）、建议（继续血管活性药、复查凝血和纤维蛋白原、继续血制品、ECMO团队待命）。不说病例中没有的数据。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance: says the problem out loud ('sudden hypoxaemia and hypotension during the caesarean — possible amniotic fluid embolism — I need help'), calls for help explicitly and gives roles (airway, drugs, scribe, blood, calls to the blood bank, ICU and ECMO); gives specific orders (drug, dose, route) and has them read back; summarises regularly ('BP is now…, we have given…, next…'). At transfer, an SBAR handover: situation (cardiorespiratory collapse during the caesarean, suspected amniotic fluid embolism), background (40+6 weeks, ruptured membranes with yellow-green liquor, chest and abdominal discomfort and vomiting during positioning, rapid-sequence induction, delivery within 5 minutes), assessment (gas, clotting, echo, current ventilatory and circulatory support, blood products given), recommendation (continue vasoactive drugs, repeat clotting and fibrinogen, continue blood products, ECMO team on standby). Uses no data the case does not contain.

name.zh-CN: 乔护士（手术室巡回护士）

knowledge.zh-CN: 交班：34岁，第一次怀孕，孕40+6周，在手术台上准备剖宫产，拟腰麻。手术室有麻醉机（可纯氧通气）、监护仪、吸引器、墙壁氧气、1台输液泵和药柜；手术室里没有抢救车和超声——静脉穿刺包在病房、ICU或急诊的抢救车上，心脏超声仪在放射科超声室，可推过来；血制品由检验科血库发出；ICU和普通病房护士站有病历终端。会复述医嘱（闭环沟通），只报告观察到的情况，不解读结果，不下诊断。
knowledge.en: Handover: 34, first pregnancy, 40+6 weeks, on the operating table for a caesarean with a planned spinal. The theatre has an anaesthesia machine (can ventilate with 100% oxygen), a monitor, suction, wall oxygen, one infusion pump and a drug cabinet. There is no resuscitation trolley or ultrasound in theatre: the cannulation kit is on the ward, ICU or ED resuscitation trolleys, and the echo machine is in the radiology ultrasound room and can be wheeled over; blood products come from the laboratory blood bank; the ICU and ward nurses' stations have records terminals. Reads orders back (closed loop), reports only what she observes, does not interpret results or diagnose.

name.zh-CN: 罗医生（麻醉科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教：只追问学员已获得的资料，例如“她的症状是在什么时候开始的？”“胎心60次/分意味着什么？”“为什么这时选快速顺序诱导？”“什么原因能同时解释低氧、低血压和凝血异常？记录排除了哪些？”“足月孕妇的纤维蛋白原为什么要按妊娠生理来解读？”“为什么补液要限量？”“SpO₂测不出说明什么、不说明什么？”。学员作出病因决策之前，不点名任何诊断或相关指南；之后可以讲解SMFM 2016指南、SMFM检查清单（2021，2026更新）、中国2018共识的5条诊断标准与Clark 2016研究定义的区别，以及原报告的历史处理与现行推荐的不同。不补充病例中没有的数据。
knowledge.en: Socratic teacher: asks only about information the learner already has — 'When did her symptoms start?', 'What does a fetal heart of 60/min mean?', 'Why rapid-sequence induction now?', 'What could explain hypoxaemia, hypotension and abnormal clotting together — and which causes does the record exclude?', 'Why read a term fibrinogen against pregnancy physiology?', 'Why limit the fluid?', 'What does an unreadable SpO₂ tell you, and what doesn't it?'. Before the learner has made the cause decision, names no diagnosis or guideline; afterwards may teach SMFM 2016, the SMFM checklist (2021, updated 2026), the five criteria of the Chinese 2018 consensus versus the Clark 2016 research definition, and how the report's historical management differs from current recommendations. Adds no data the case does not contain.

name.zh-CN: 郑医生（产科主任医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 主刀医生，学员要求时可立即开始剖宫产。可以解释胎心约60次/分对胎儿的意义和即刻剖宫产的指征。被问到术中出血量时如实说明病例没有记录。不评论学员尚未获得的结果，不替学员下诊断。
knowledge.en: The operating obstetrician; can start the caesarean at once when the learner asks. Can explain what a fetal heart of about 60/min means for the baby and the indications for a category-1 caesarean. Asked about the blood loss, says honestly that the case does not record it. Does not comment on results the learner has not obtained and does not diagnose for the learner.

name.zh-CN: 钱老师（检验科输血组）

knowledge.zh-CN: 负责发血：可解释大量输血方案的组成，冷沉淀与血浆在纤维蛋白原含量和容量上的差别，以及同型血和紧急发血的流程。只解释学员已拿到的凝血结果，以报告原文为准；不透露尚未阅读的结果，不下诊断。
knowledge.en: Issues the blood: can explain what a massive transfusion protocol contains, how cryoprecipitate and plasma differ in fibrinogen content and volume, and how group-specific and emergency issue work. Explains only clotting results the learner already has, in the report's own words; reveals no unread results and does not diagnose.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：剖宫产术中的心肺循环衰竭
title.en: Debrief: cardiorespiratory collapse during a caesarean

conclusion.zh-CN: 作者诊断为围手术期羊水栓塞：摆腰麻体位时出现心前区及腹部不适、呕吐和胎心减慢，快速顺序诱导全麻、胎儿娩出后突发低氧、极度低血压和凝血异常；在排除产科出血、过敏反应和高位椎管内阻滞等原因后确定。她经多学科抢救和ICU支持，术后第2天拔管、第6天出院。
conclusion.en: The authors diagnosed perioperative amniotic fluid embolism: precordial and abdominal discomfort, vomiting and a fetal bradycardia while she was positioned for the spinal, then sudden hypoxaemia, profound hypotension and coagulopathy after rapid-sequence induction and delivery — diagnosed after excluding obstetric haemorrhage, anaphylaxis and a high neuraxial block. With multidisciplinary resuscitation and ICU support she was extubated on postoperative day 2 and went home on day 6.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 侧过身后出现的心前区及腹部不适、呕吐，加上胎心约60次/分，都发生在循环衰竭之前，可能是最早的表现（原文未就此作解读）；作者认为麻醉医生在场、持续监测，是本例能被早期发现的原因。
keyReasoning.en: The chest and abdominal discomfort and the vomiting on turning, with a fetal heart of about 60/min, all came before the collapse and may have been its first signs (the report does not interpret them); the authors credit continuous monitoring with the anaesthetist present for the early recognition.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: SpO₂测不出不等于0：常见于外周灌注极差；血气报告PaO₂正常，但采样时点和吸氧浓度未记录，不能据此说明氧合良好。
keyReasoning.en: An unreadable SpO₂ is not zero — it usually reflects very poor peripheral perfusion; the gas reports a normal PaO₂, but its timing and FiO₂ are not recorded, so it does not prove oxygenation was adequate.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 术中心脏超声左室射血分数正常、右室不大：羊水栓塞早期多为急性右心衰竭，而这一次检查的时点未记录，既不能证实也不能排除羊水栓塞；它让大面积肺栓塞的可能性变小。
keyReasoning.en: The intra-operative echo (normal ejection fraction, non-dilated right ventricle): early amniotic fluid embolism is usually acute right-heart failure, but the timing of this single study is unknown, so it neither confirms nor excludes amniotic fluid embolism; it does make a massive pulmonary embolism less likely.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 原文对PT的两种表述（病例部分写“延长”，讨论部分为12.5 s、无参考范围）都照录；判断凝血病要看纤维蛋白原、D-二聚体、APTT和变化趋势，而不是一个PT。
keyReasoning.en: Both statements about the PT are kept as published ('prolonged' in the case presentation; 12.5 s without a range in the discussion); judge the coagulopathy on fibrinogen, D-dimer, APTT and the trend, not on one PT.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 原报告的多种处理——肾上腺素、去甲肾上腺素和多巴胺同时使用，氢化可的松“抗过敏”，快速补液，补碱——是病例的事实，单例报告不能证明其中任何一项的独立获益。
keyReasoning.en: The report's many measures — adrenaline, noradrenaline and dopamine together, hydrocortisone as 'anti-allergy' treatment, rapid fluids, bicarbonate — are facts of the record; a single case cannot show that any one of them helped.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告，不能证明某项治疗的独立疗效。病例记录不含药物剂量、失血量、血小板计数、连续血气和长期结局；决策和评分是教学设计，正确选项依据所引的现行指南。
boundaries.en: A single case report: it cannot show that any one treatment worked. The record has no drug doses, blood loss, platelet count, serial gases or long-term outcome; the decisions and scoring are educational design, and the correct options follow the cited current guidance.

unknowns.zh-CN: 腰麻是否实际实施（原文在摆体位后直接记录全身麻醉）。
unknowns.en: Whether the spinal was actually given (the report goes straight from positioning to general anaesthesia).

unknowns.zh-CN: 禁食情况、过敏史、既往史、用药、孕期并发症、产时体温。
unknowns.en: Fasting status, allergies, past history, medicines, pregnancy complications and her temperature in labour.

unknowns.zh-CN: 胎心和复测生命体征的具体数值；诱导药物、各种血管活性药、激素和碳酸氢钠的剂量；输液种类和总量。
unknowns.en: The exact fetal heart and repeat vital-sign values; the induction drugs and the doses of the vasoactive drugs, steroids and bicarbonate; the type and total volume of fluid.

unknowns.zh-CN: 失血量、血小板计数、凝血参考范围，以及PaO₂、PaCO₂、乳酸、碱剩余数值和采样时点。
unknowns.en: Blood loss, platelet count, clotting reference ranges, and the PaO₂, PaCO₂, lactate and base-excess values and sampling times.

unknowns.zh-CN: 心脏超声的方式（经胸或经食管）和时点；降低肺动脉压力和利尿所用的药物；血制品在手术室与ICU之间的分配。
unknowns.en: How and when the echo was done (transthoracic or transoesophageal); the drugs used to lower pulmonary pressure and for diuresis; how the blood products were split between theatre and ICU.

unknowns.zh-CN: Apgar评分的评分时间点、婴儿此后的情况，以及长期母婴结局。
unknowns.en: The times of the Apgar scores, the baby's later course, and long-term outcomes for mother and baby.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 羊水栓塞是排除其他病因后的临床诊断，没有能确诊或排除它的实验室检查（SMFM临床指南第9号，2016，2024年再确认）。中国2018共识要求同时满足5条标准（急性低血压或心脏骤停、急性低氧、凝血功能障碍的实验室或临床证据、发生于分娩/剖宫产中或产后短时间内、其他疾病无法解释），本例全部符合；Clark 2016研究定义另外要求显性DIC，本例记录无法证明。研究标准用于统一报告病例，不是床旁诊断规则。
teachingPoints.en: Amniotic fluid embolism is a clinical diagnosis of exclusion; no laboratory test confirms or refutes it (SMFM Clinical Guideline #9, 2016, reaffirmed 2024). The Chinese 2018 consensus requires all five of its criteria (acute hypotension or arrest; acute hypoxaemia; laboratory or clinical evidence of coagulopathy; onset during labour, caesarean or shortly after; no other explanation) — this case meets them all; the Clark 2016 research definition also requires overt DIC, which this record cannot show. Research criteria standardise case reporting; they are not a bedside rule.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 立即呼叫多学科团队，按标准基础和高级生命支持处理心脏骤停；孕周≥23周者心脏骤停后应立即娩出胎儿（SMFM 2016）。SMFM检查清单（2021，2026年更新）是团队的认知辅助工具；2026版把呼叫帮助、纯氧和静脉通路视为已成常规的步骤。
teachingPoints.en: Call the multidisciplinary team at once and treat arrest with standard basic and advanced life support; after an arrest at ≥ 23 weeks, deliver immediately (SMFM 2016). The SMFM checklist (2021; updated 2026) is the team's cognitive aid; the 2026 version treats calling for help, 100% oxygen and IV access as steps that are already routine.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 保证氧合与通气，按血流动力学使用血管活性药和正性肌力药，避免过量补液（SMFM 2016，GRADE 1C）；检查清单作者建议补液每次不超过500 mL。原报告记录的“快速补液”没有写明输液量——这是历史记录与现行推荐需要对照的地方。
teachingPoints.en: Secure oxygenation and ventilation, use vasopressors and inotropes as the haemodynamics require, and avoid excessive fluid (SMFM 2016, GRADE 1C); the checklist's authors limit fluid challenges to 500 mL. The report's 'rapid fluids' has no recorded volume — the point where the historical record and current advice need comparing.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 凝血障碍常紧随循环衰竭出现：尽早评估凝血，按标准大量输血方案积极处理出血（SMFM 2016）；担心容量负荷时以冷沉淀代替血浆（SMFM检查清单作者）。妊娠晚期纤维蛋白原本应升高，足月1.38 g/L明显偏低。不常规使用肝素（中国2018共识）。
teachingPoints.en: Coagulopathy often follows the collapse: assess clotting early and manage bleeding aggressively with a standard massive transfusion protocol (SMFM 2016); use cryoprecipitate rather than plasma when volume is a concern (the SMFM checklist's authors). Fibrinogen rises in late pregnancy, so 1.38 g/L at term is markedly low. Heparin is not used routinely (Chinese 2018 consensus).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 糖皮质激素：SMFM 2016没有推荐；中国2018共识认为存在争议，但视早期大剂量使用为“有益的尝试”（氢化可的松500–1000 mg/d）。原报告的激素、多巴胺、补碱和“抗过敏”肾上腺素都是记录在案的处理，不是个体获益的证据。
teachingPoints.en: Corticosteroids: SMFM 2016 does not recommend them; the Chinese 2018 consensus calls them controversial but regards early high-dose use as 'a worthwhile attempt' (hydrocortisone 500–1000 mg/day). The report's steroids, dopamine, bicarbonate and 'anti-allergy' adrenaline are recorded measures, not evidence that they helped her.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 羊水栓塞早期多为急性右心衰竭，床旁心脏超声有助于确认（SMFM检查清单作者）；一次时点不明的检查显示右室不大，既不能证实也不能排除诊断。对难治性心肺衰竭，可考虑体外生命支持（ECMO）——原报告让ECMO团队待命（其参考文献：Viau-Lapointe与Filewod，2019）。
teachingPoints.en: Early amniotic fluid embolism is usually acute right-heart failure, which bedside echocardiography can confirm (the SMFM checklist's authors); one study of unknown timing showing a non-dilated right ventricle neither confirms nor excludes the diagnosis. For refractory cardiorespiratory collapse, extracorporeal life support (ECMO) can be considered — the report had the ECMO team standing by (its reference: Viau-Lapointe and Filewod, 2019).
